title: This Shrimp's Claw Snap Hits 218 Decibels

scenes.text: This shrimp snaps its claw at 218 decibels.
The snap fires a bubble out at 56 miles an hour.
It stuns fish nearby without ever touching them.
Then the bubble collapses with a bang and even a flash of light.
Small fish can be killed by the pressure alone.
No bite. No punch. Just a snap from a shrimp that fits in your palm.

description:
A pistol shrimp's claw snap hits 218 decibels and fires a bubble at 56 miles an hour.
The collapsing bubble stuns fish and can kill small ones, no contact needed.
Would you want one in your aquarium?
first_comment: Would you rather be stunned by a shrimp or stung by a jellyfish?
